name: centry-global-tax-calendar
description:
Build a cross-border obligations register from user-confirmed dates and two narrowly supported UK Self Assessment 2025–2026 milestones. Separate confirmed and unconfirmed applicability, deadline sources and proposed owners. Preview reminder dates and export the register; no reminders, messages, returns or payments are sent.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

Only two named UK 2025–2026 milestones are built in. Other dates and applicability are supplied claims; reminder dates are previews and nothing is scheduled, sent, filed or paid. Only two named UK 2025–2026 deadline modules are validated; other dates are user/adviser-supplied and not independently verified. No obligation applicability, tax liability, general deadline exceptions, extensions, holidays or filing method determination. Reminder dates are an exportable preview only; no notification, calendar event, message, filing or payment is scheduled or sent. A proposed owner is not appointed. A user-confirmed deadline or owner remains a user assertion unless the relevant source is supplied.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release of Centry Global Tax Calendar: Build a cross-border obligations register from user-confirmed dates and two narrowly supported UK Self Assessment 2025–2026 milestones. Separate confirmed and unconfirmed applicability, deadline sources and proposed owners. Preview reminder dates and export the register; no reminders, messages, returns or payments are sent. Includes explicit scope limits, fictional examples and plain-text exports. Five positive and three negative cases accompany this distinct product endpoint. No account or payment is required for the planning utility.
